title: Gaps between check-ins
hints: zip(checkins, checkins[1:]) yields (earlier, later) pairs and naturally stops one short, so empty and single-element inputs produce nothing.
Subtracting two datetimes gives a timedelta; call .total_seconds() on it to get a float.
Wrap the zip in enumerate(..., start=1) so you have the index of `later` for the ValueError message when later < earlier.
